`module.aws_eks_teams` creates Kubernetes namespaces, RBAC objects, service accounts, and `kubectl_manifest` resources, but it does not wait for the `kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` readiness/auth barrier that the other Kubernetes-facing modules use. It should depend on `kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` so the cluster API is ready and aws-auth is configured before team Kubernetes resources are applied.

`kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` already depends on `module.aws_eks` transitively through `data.http.eks_cluster_readiness` -> `data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster`; the explicit `depends_on` entry on `module.aws_eks` is redundant.

`kubernetes_config_map.amazon_vpc_cni` already depends on `module.aws_eks` transitively through `data.http.eks_cluster_readiness` -> `data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster`; the explicit `depends_on` entry on `module.aws_eks` is redundant.
`aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` already references `aws_iam_role.managed_ng` through `node_role_arn`, so its explicit `depends_on` on the same role is redundant.

`aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng` already depends on `aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng` through `module.launch_template_self_managed_ng`, whose launch template configuration references the instance profile; the explicit `depends_on` on the instance profile is redundant.
`null_resource.update_trust_policy` already interpolates `kubernetes_namespace.spark.id` in its command, so the explicit `depends_on` on that namespace is redundant.

`aws_launch_template.managed_node_groups` already depends on `aws_iam_role.managed_ng` transitively through the explicitly listed `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.managed_ng`; the explicit role dependency is redundant.
`null_resource.update_trust_policy` already interpolates `aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id` in its command, so the explicit `depends_on` on that role is redundant.

`aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng` already depends on `aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng` transitively through `module.launch_template_self_managed_ng` -> `aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng`; the explicit `depends_on` on the role is redundant.
